purpose: Research-only handoff for nums 248-252 in data-dcom.js and nums 253-258 and 260-268 in data-disney.js. Built from live Common Sense Media refetches of catalog srcUrl pages. Do not treat as production data until reviewed and transformed through the official workflow.

contentFlagModel.mappingNote: This refetch preserves CSM's current visible category label and proposes the nearest app level. Production catalog edits should be made only by the follow-up importer/reviewer.

entries.title: Spin

violence.summary: The main concern is emotional rather than violent: Rhea's mother has died, flashbacks are sad, and characters briefly express mild mistrust or negative feelings.

language.summary: CSM notes only brief expressions of dislike and mistrust, without profanity.

romance.summary: A teen crush runs through the story, with hand-holding and some midriff-baring outfits but no sexualized content.

drinking.summary: CSM does not surface drinking, drug, or smoking content.

handoffNotes: Grief over a deceased parent may need prose context.

entries.title: Under Wraps

violence.summary: Early spooky moments include the mummy coming to life and chasing frightened kids, but the scare softens once he is established as friendly and comic.

language.summary: CSM does not surface language content.

romance.summary: CSM does not surface sex, romance, or nudity content.

drinking.summary: CSM does not surface drinking, drug, or smoking content.

handoffNotes: CSM detail text appears to contain a typo: "chasea kids."

entries.title: Christmas…Again?!

violence.summary: A repeating bully incident involves pushing kids and stealing lunch money, and Rowena makes dramatic hostile comments that are framed as tween frustration rather than real threats.

language.summary: Mild words such as "jerk," "butt," and "heck" appear, along with rude family arguments and exaggerated hostile phrases.

romance.summary: Adults in committed relationships kiss and show mild affection; Rowena wants her divorced parents to fall back in love.

drinking.summary: CSM does not surface drinking, drug, or smoking content.

handoffNotes: The repeated "I'm going to kill him" style dialogue is not treated by CSM as sincere violence but may need careful wording.

entries.title: Zombies 3

violence.summary: Light fantasy action includes fights, chases, electrocutions, threats, punches, falls, and monster transformations that CSM says are not realistic or very scary.

language.summary: Language is limited to very mild interspecies taunting and threats.

romance.summary: Dating characters kiss on cheeks, nuzzle noses, cuddle, flirt, and in a few cases share actual kisses.

drinking.summary: CSM does not surface drinking, drug, or smoking content.

handoffNotes: Live CSM age is 8+, while the current catalog CA is 7+.

violence.summary: Mild spooky content includes a few jump scares, brief peril, and fantasy sparring with magical beams.

language.summary: CSM does not surface language content.

romance.summary: Love is a secondary theme, and a couple marries and kisses at the end of the ceremony.

drinking.summary: CSM does not surface drinking, drug, or smoking content.

entries.title: Pinocchio

violence.summary: Threats and peril include a gun fired at a suspected intruder, boys fighting and destroying property, cartoon impacts, Pinocchio being kidnapped and caged, threats of destruction, separation from his father, and near-drowning.

language.summary: CSM does not surface language content.

romance.summary: A brief gag has Jiminy Cricket accidentally putting his hand on a female statue's rear.

drinking.summary: Smoking and alcohol are frequent for a family classic: Geppetto smokes, children smoke cigars, Pinocchio drinks beer and acts intoxicated, tavern characters drink and smoke, and Stromboli drinks wine.

handoffNotes: Substance content is a larger current CSM signal than many parents may remember.

entries.title: Fantasia

violence.summary: Unsettling animated sequences include Mickey losing control of magical brooms, storms and floods, volcanic destruction, a dinosaur fight to the death, ghosts, skeletons, vultures, bats, and alligators.

language.summary: CSM does not surface language content.

romance.summary: Animated nymphs, centaurs, and cherubs are nude or partially nude during courtship imagery, with one brief nipple shot but no genital detail.

drinking.summary: The Pastoral Symphony sequence includes wine-drinking gods, humans, and animals, and Bacchus becomes drunk.

handoffNotes: Violence label is only "a little," but the imagery may still be intense for sensitive younger children.

entries.title: Dumbo

violence.summary: Dumbo is bullied and separated from his mother, Mrs. Jumbo is chained and isolated after defending him, circus workers are thrown around, and Dumbo's circus act brings down the tent.

language.summary: CSM does not surface language content.

romance.summary: CSM notes the stork delivery of animal babies may prompt questions from young children, but no romance or nudity concern is flagged.

drinking.summary: Clowns are visibly drinking in silhouette, and Dumbo and Timothy accidentally get drunk, leading into the trippy Pink Elephants sequence.

handoffNotes: Racially dated crow portrayals are outside the four requested flags but may merit separate catalog prose.

entries.title: Bambi

violence.summary: CSM flags several frightening scenes: Bambi's mother is killed off-screen, a quail is shot and shown dead, fire consumes the forest, thunderstorms scare the animals, young bucks fight, and hunting dogs chase Faline.

language.summary: CSM does not surface language content.

romance.summary: Adolescent animals pair off in spring, flirt, snuggle, kiss, and later have babies.

drinking.summary: CSM does not surface drinking, drug, or smoking content.

handoffNotes: Parent death and hunting scenes need clear prose context for younger viewers.

entries.title: Saludos Amigos

violence.summary: The combined CSM review notes guns fired into the air, a singing gun barrel gag, Donald and a llama nearly falling from a high bridge, baby-plane crash peril, and Goofy carrying and biting a hunting knife.

language.summary: CSM calls the lyrics dated but innocuous, including the period use of "gay caballeros."

romance.summary: The combined review notes Donald whistling at Latina women, one kiss, beach-ogling narration, Goofy's underwear gags, and a nonsexualized "making love" line.

drinking.summary: The combined review includes Donald getting drunk from one cocktail, adults drinking wine, and Jose Carioca frequently smoking a cigar.

handoffNotes: Catalog srcUrl redirects to CSM's combined Classic Caballeros Collection review for Saludos Amigos and The Three Caballeros.
Because the CSM review covers both films together, some category details may belong more strongly to The Three Caballeros than Saludos Amigos.

entries.title: The Three Caballeros

violence.summary: The combined CSM review notes caballero gunplay, a surreal singing gun-barrel gag, bridge and plane peril, and a hunting knife gag.

language.summary: CSM calls the dated lyrics innocuous, including the period phrase "gay caballeros."

romance.summary: Donald whistles at Latina women and gets one kiss, narration comments on women at the beach, Goofy has underwear gags, and a toucan line uses "making love" nonsexually.

drinking.summary: Donald gets drunk from a cocktail, adults drink wine, and Jose Carioca is rarely shown without a cigar.

handoffNotes: Catalog srcUrl redirects to CSM's combined Classic Caballeros Collection review for Saludos Amigos and The Three Caballeros.

entries.title: Fun and Fancy Free

violence.summary: Peril includes Bongo being chased by a larger bear, lightning, cliff and waterfall danger, a giant kidnapping the harp, starving farmers, Mickey nearly being eaten, Donald threatening to kill the cow, and the giant falling from the beanstalk.

language.summary: CSM's detail text lists only "stupid."

romance.summary: Bongo and Lulu Bell fall in love, snuggle, dance, and rub noses while a jealous bear chases Lulu Bell.

drinking.summary: CSM does not surface drinking, drug, or smoking content.

handoffNotes: CSM labels Language and Sex, Romance & Nudity as none despite minor detail text.

entries.title: Melody Time

violence.summary: CSM notes shooting in a cowboy segment, racist violence toward Native characters, storm danger for boats, a skating rescue near a waterfall, a keyboard-snake gag, buzzards attacking a dying colt, and an abandoned baby raised by coyotes.

language.summary: CSM does not surface language content.

romance.summary: A woman alters her appearance to attract men, a man's attraction is played as making him lose sense, and cartoon couples kiss.

drinking.summary: A heroic character is shown smoking cigarettes.

handoffNotes: Outdated Native representation and gender stereotypes are prominent current CSM concerns outside the four flag levels.

entries.title: The Adventures of Ichabod and Mr. Toad

violence.summary: Cartoon violence includes rifles, guns, knives, swords, and hatchets, with the Headless Horseman repeatedly trying to behead Ichabod; CSM notes the horseman may be terrifying because he is never revealed as a disguise.

language.summary: CSM does not surface language content.

romance.summary: CSM does not surface sex, romance, or nudity content.

drinking.summary: Characters smoke cigars and pipes, cartoon weasels are passed out drunk near bottles and mugs, and characters raise mugs of beer before drinking.

handoffNotes: Headless Horseman scares may need stronger prose than the app level alone implies.

entries.title: Cinderella

violence.summary: Tense moments include a parent's death in narration, Lucifer chasing mice, Cinderella fleeing shadowy horses, the stepfamily destroying her gown and locking her in, brief sword chasing, head-bops, and bullying.

language.summary: Mild insults include "stupid" and "pompous windbag."

romance.summary: Cinderella briefly undresses behind a screen with bare shoulders visible, shares a chaste kiss with the prince, and the story focuses heavily on romance and marriage.

drinking.summary: The king lights a cigar and piles cigars on the Grand Duke, who briefly smokes one.

handoffNotes: CSM also flags gender-role/passivity conversation points outside the four requested category signals.

entries.title: Alice in Wonderland

violence.summary: Mild surreal peril includes Alice nearly drowning in tears, oysters being lured and killed off-screen, hostile flowers, Alice nearly destroying Rabbit's house, and the Queen repeatedly ordering beheadings before a card-army chase.

language.summary: Mild insults include "barbarian," "stupidest," "poo," "fat," "tyrant," and "weed."

romance.summary: CSM does not surface sex, romance, or nudity content.

drinking.summary: The Caterpillar repeatedly smokes a hookah, the smoke affects Alice, and two other characters smoke pipes.

handoffNotes: Hookah imagery is a clear CSM substance signal even though the movie is otherwise very young-skewing.

entries.title: Peter Pan

violence.summary: Violence and peril are frequent, with guns, swords, cannonballs, knives, clubs, kidnappings, walk-the-plank threats, a bomb plot, choking, fights, threats of throat-slitting and drowning, alligator danger, and a noose-linked Hangman's Tree reference.

language.summary: Language includes racist terms for Native people, sexist remarks, many insults, violent place names, and a reference to drugging and kidnapping someone onto a ship.

romance.summary: There are cheek kisses, Wendy trying to show Peter a kiss as he backs away, minimally clothed female characters including a mermaid covered by hair, burlesque-style walking, and jealousy over Peter's attention.

drinking.summary: Kids smoke a ceremonial pipe, adults smoke cigars, adults drink from a liquor jug and act drunk, and rum is mentioned.

handoffNotes: Racist representation, noose imagery, and frequent weapon threats need explicit prose context.

entries.title: Lady and the Tramp

violence.summary: Lady is muzzled, chased by fierce dogs, and briefly held in the pound; the Siamese cats are creepy, and the climax has a rat threatening a baby before a frantic chase where a secondary dog appears dead briefly.

language.summary: CSM does not surface language content.

romance.summary: Lady and Tramp share gentle romance, including the spaghetti kiss, a romantic dinner, references to Tramp's past relationships, jealousy, dog marriage mentions, and puppies by the end.

drinking.summary: CSM does not surface drinking, drug, or smoking content.

handoffNotes: CSM separately flags racist Siamese-cat caricatures outside the four requested flags.

entries.title: Sleeping Beauty

violence.summary: Maleficent's menace drives the scares: she becomes a fire-breathing dragon, fights Philip, nearly sends him over a cliff, has him kidnapped and beaten in shadow, rains boulders on him, fires lightning, and lures Aurora in a trance toward the spinning wheel.

language.summary: Maleficent uses insults including "fools," "idiots," and "imbeciles," plus one reference to hell.

romance.summary: CSM labels romance as none and notes only a kiss.

drinking.summary: The kings drink to their children's planned marriage, and the minstrel drinks the leftovers until he falls over drunk under the table.

handoffNotes: Dragon battle and trance-to-spinning-wheel sequence may need clear scariness context.

entries.title: One Hundred and One Dalmatians

violence.summary: Cruella is frightening, puppies are kidnapped and threatened with being skinned for a coat, Horace and Jasper make threats, suspense is sustained, and high-speed chases end with villain cars crashing off a cliff.

language.summary: Mild insults and threats include "idiot," "imbecile," "fools," "shut up," "twerps," "clumsy clod," "bumbling blockheads," "witch," "scoundrels," "inhuman beast," and "rascals."

romance.summary: Roger and Anita flirt and kiss chastely, Pongo and Perdita rub noses, both couples marry, and the dogs are later raising puppies.

drinking.summary: Cruella smokes cigarettes in nearly every scene, Roger smokes a pipe, and Horace and Jasper drink wine straight from a bottle.

handoffNotes: Cruella's fur-coat scheme and smoking are major current CSM signals.
